en: Multiview color postcard labeled CAREI – JUDEȚUL SATU MARE, showing three scenes: left, the neo‑Gothic Károlyi Castle with its crenellated tower; center, a modernist obelisk and sculpted soldier heads of the Monumentul Ostașului Român set among flowerbeds; right, a communist‑era apartment block with landscaped flowers. The reverse has a Romanian handwritten message, Romanian stamp and postmarks, and printed publisher details.
